detail.longDescription: Fish Audio has released Live 3, a full-duplex voice model for voice agents that listens while it speaks, learning turn-taking from real conversations rather than pipeline thresholds. It can acknowledge a caller in 186 ms, tell a backchannel from a real interruption and wait out corrections. English only at launch, no benchmarks yet, hosted or on-premises. https://www. marktechpost.com/2026/11/10/fi sh-audio-live-3-full-duplex-voice-model/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
